content: <<Emi ongwunani bɛyi emi otsani, gadɔ dafi ani ka natsondu ewen onɛnɛ nɛni.>>
Onɔ ngwi a fwon le gbɔdzɛ yi ama mi ondu Aramai nɛ, a si zumyɛ. Nɛta iPol gbɛɛ:

<<Ani li inggisɛ iJuda, a mba ani mi iTasu mi iSilisia, kpaa ani she mi igeli nɛni. Mi abɔ mgbi iGamalie a nyɛ ani klɛklɛ mi ola mgbi emi otseyi, n di fyumfye itukwu mbi Imgbasho yɛyɛ dafi ema kpaa dzɛ inɛ nɛni.
Ani nu ama okyɛdɔ Ofɛ nɛ isɔ nghataa kaka ikwongye mgbi ama, di bwa engyaa yi engyulɔ gbe ma wo obawi.
Okwukwo inggisɛ ofifɛ bɛyi engyukwo okwakye duu kpaa ka kyɔ obwɛndɛ. A di nu ani afɛ kɛ mbi emi ongwunɔma ama nto iDamasiko, ikye oka bwa ma dafi emi obawi mani, gbe ma ba iJerosalin wa kwo ma adɔ.
<<Mi onɔ idzidzɛ udɛ ngwi ani dzɛ kwɛkwɛ okaka iDamasiko nɛta, osa tɔkyɛ esho wa dzaniwo akponyi.
Man ani gyɛkɛ esɛ si fwo ela le gbɔ yi ani gbɛɛ, <ISol! iSol! Kyɔsinɛ ngwi abu le nu ani isɔ?>
Ani byun gbɛɛ, << <Li abu emɛ Otsɛ? O nya ani gbɛɛ, << <Ani li iYesu ongwi iNadzareti, ngwu abu le nun isɔ mani.
Ama nkyɛ yi ani di osa nani, kpaa a fwo ela mgbi ongwu nle gbɔdzɛ yi ani ma ba.
Ani byun gbɛɛ, << <Li alungwɔ ngwi ani ka kyɔ?> Otsɛ nya ani gbɛɛ, << <Kyato; lu iDamasiko. Mi imbe na a ka nya abu alungwɔ ngwi a kye dzɛ gbɛɛ abu ka kyɔ duu.>
Ama nkyɛ yi ani ma byi ani abɔ kaka iDamasiko, ikyesinɛ osa na bulu ani inɛ.
<<Ongyulɔ iyin gbɛɛ Anania ba owa di ani. O li ngyo ola saan di dzɛ yi mmwɛ mbi emi iJuda ama nto imbe na duu.
O kwulɛsɛ dzɛ ani kɛ agya si nya ani gbɛɛ, <<Ongwunani iSol, inɛ mgbi abu no kwulu!>> Mi onɔ na yɛyɛ ta ani yagba dun.
<<O si nya ani gbɛɛ, <Imgbasho mgbi emi otseyi dulu abu gbɛɛ ni abu ye oweka mgban di di Ongwu Nle Nyaan na diyɛ fwo odzɛ mi ondun.
Abu ka li obwɛndɛ mgban mbi inggisɛ duu mi ungwɔ ngwi abu di diyɛ fwo nɛni.
Ma li ekyɛ ngwi abu le fɛ onɛnɛ? Kyato, kwu mi iyi mgban nu ma kyɔ abu iBatisima di salu ali ibwubwe mgbi abu ngwuta.>
<<Ngwi ani yɛ luba iJerosalin dile bibɔ mi ozu okwukwo osunu Imgbasho nɛ, ani di inɛ odiidi
di di Otsɛ iYesu le gbɔdzɛ yi ani gbɛɛ, <Lu dzata iJerosalin Plɛ, ikyesinɛ a ka gbela obwɛndɛ mgbi abu onuunu ikye ani ba.>
Nghaduu ani gbɛɛ, << <Otsɛ, inggisɛ ntonɛ ye ani dafi ani kyikyɛ mi ozu okwakye mgbi emi iJuda kpatsɛ, ikye ogbe ama nnoyɛyɛ mi iyi mgbi abu wo obawi di gbo ma ibe mani.
Onɔ ngwi a tsɛngwɔ iStivin ikyegbɛɛ o le kyɔ obwɛndɛ mi iyi mgbi abu ma, ani kwudzɛ ele di gbela yi ongwɔɔngwɔ mgban di ngyo angwuto mgbi ama nle ngwɔn mani.>
<<Ta Otsɛ iYesu si nya ani gbɛɛ, <Lu, ani ka dɔ abu esɔ lu kpini mbi Udzengye.> >>
IPol inggisɛ iRoma
Ibyi inggisɛ gadɔ mbi iPol nghataa o gbɔdzɛ nɛ ngyɛ. Man a kyile ela ondonyi gbɛɛ, <<Ngwɔn na, o mɛ odzɛ oshishe ba!>>
Dafi a le wulu di fwadulu angwuto mgbi ama ngwuta dile tombulu kɛ esho nɛ,
agyegika nu ondu nu ma kye iPol kaka ogalu oblakwutsɛ. O nu ondu gbɛɛ nu ma gbon di byun ita, nu ma ye ungwɔ nkyɔ duuse ibyi inggisɛ tole fan ela ngha mani.
Dafi a nan lasɛ ogbon nɛ, iPol byi ongyukwo oblakwutsɛ nkwudzɛ mmana ma gbɛɛ, <<Li ola ni abu gbo inggisɛ iRoma ngwu a gbɔn ikwɔ di tun yi obube ba kpaa ibee?>>
Ngwi ongyukwo na fwo ngha nɛ, o kɛ mbi okwukwo ogbakwu na ka kye tson gbɛɛ, <<Li ekyɛ abu le kyɔ? Inggisɛ nɛ li inggisɛ iRoma.>>
Okwukwo ogbakwu na kɛ mbi iPol ka byun gbɛɛ, <<Nya ani n di abu li inggisɛ iRomaa?>> O gbɛɛ, <<Ɛɛn, ani li inggisɛ iRoma.
Nɛ okwukwo ogbakwu na gbɛɛ, <<Ani kpa udza she ikye oyɛɛ inggisɛ iRoma.>> IPol nyan gbɛɛ, <<Nghaduu ani yɔ ani li imba mgbi iRoma.>>
Ama nwewo obyin ita ma byakpa yɛyikpa. Okwukwo ogbakwu na abuon ewo waa lon onɔ ngwi o difwi gbɛɛ iPol li inggisɛ iRoma kpaa ongwu tan itse mani.
IPol kɛdzɛ inɛ okwakye mgbiemi iJuda

Tegblifan, ngwi i mina agyegika na oye itɔdzɛ yɛyɛ ngwi emi iJuda gbe odzɛ tukwu iPol ewo nɛ, o shan adi ta di nu ondu ni engyukwo ama ofifɛ bɛyi okwakye mgbi engyukwo duu kwakye. Ta o si kye iPol ba non dzɛkunto mi iyayi ma.
